Subject: Post-call: ACME pilot path & legal routing checkpoint

Thanks for the time today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a clear routing plan to get the pilot started. Short version: we need an NDA, security questionnaire pass, and an MSA redline agreement before procurement issues the PO.

Call recap (high level)
- Pilot scope: 3-week sandbox for clinical notes extraction (PHI minimized).
- Success criteria: 95% extraction recall for designated data set, <200ms median latency for test loads.
- Decision cadence: economic buyer (Ethan) + procurement signoff required. Legal will review MSA/DPA.

Requests / asks
1) Please confirm the procurement contact and the legal reviewer for MSA redlines.
2) Can you confirm target timeline for NDA and MSA review (est. bd = business days)?
3) Any mandatory security or data residency clauses up front (SSO/SAML, logging retention)?

Proposed mutual action plan (draft)
- Day 0: Redwood sends NDA (fast-track PDF attached) and MAP-draft (attached).
- Day 1-5: Acme signs NDA (DocuSign), procurement provides intake form.
- Day 6-14: Security questionnaire exchange; Redwood provides answers + architecture diagram.
- Day 7-28: MSA redline and negotiation (legal).
- After sign: PO and pilot kick-off.

Attachments: redwood_standard_nnda_v3.pdf (for signature), MAP-draft-ACME.xlsx

I copied Ben and Marissa to own the contract logistics and follow-through. If you can point me to your procurement intake form or the person owning the legal review, I’ll route documents and propose a DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,

Ethan / team — adding suggested sequencing and owner assignments from Redwood’s side to reduce friction:

Suggested sequencing (owner / target bd)
- NDA (Redwood Legal → Acme Legal) — owner: Monica / Ben; target: 3–5 business days if standard mutual NDA.
- Security questionnaire (Redwood Solutions → Acme Security) — owner: Marissa; target: 2–3 business days to provide answers and architecture doc.
- MSA redline (Redwood Legal → Acme Legal) — owner: Redwood Legal (Ben as interface); target: 10–14 business days typical for initial review; punches on liability/data residency could extend.
- Procurement PO issuance — owner: Acme Procurement; target: 5–7 business days after MSA sign-off.

Redline sequencing recommendation
1) Execute mutual NDA first to enable exchange of the full security questionnaire and architecture diagrams.
2) Run security questionnaire in parallel with MSA redline to shorten calendar time; questionnaires rarely shift contractual terms, but they inform DPA clauses.
3) Limit the first MSA redline to operational / data-processing items; push policy/legal exceptions to a secondary review to avoid blocking the pilot.

Fallbacks if timing slips
- Temporary limited-scope PO with data minimization addendum (short-term) to allow sandbox access while legal finalizes full MSA.
- Put the pilot on a time-limited evaluation agreement (30 days) — smaller legal lift.

Attaching: redwood_contract_playbook.pdf (playbook + expected turn-times). I’ll be available to join any legal calls to speed alignment.

Ben Carter
